current_finding: Canonical SWAP5 still has no admitted salt owner or salinity response. The work branch now has an optional per-node salt-mass component on the shared FMR physical state, an independent solute-layout identity, Restart v3 validation with v2 disabled-only compatibility, and clone copying. The A7 O0/O2 test now round-trips an active salt mass through Restart v3, checks clone mass identity, rejects negative/wrong-node state, rejects an active-salt v2 restart without mutating the target, and accepts a disabled-salt v2 restart. This qualifies only the narrow state/layout serialization contract. The FMR trial still rejects every active solute layout; no salt mass advances with the accepted water transaction. The restricted accepted-water-substep trace remains opt-in, deterministic and fail-closed on unsupported routes. The Maas-Hoffman response and mobile-salt transport remain independent prototypes; Jarvis remains fail-closed for salinity.

Source-family census additionally establishes SWINCO-dependent initial versus warm-restart concentration profiles, CMSY inventory derived from water content/CML and optional Freundlich sorption, explicit boundary and drainage fluxes, internal solute substeps, and root salt uptake TSCF*qrot*CML. Exact B1.11 solute-member and restart details remain unverified in this execution.

Focused O0/O2 salinity tests pass, including a manufactured and restricted real-Reference-Richards conservative internal water-face-flux reconstruction. The direct solve includes nonzero qssdi and separately bound nonzero qrot. The A8 O0/O2 FMR transaction/restart suite now passes with nonzero qrot, after correcting incomplete test-only matrix_area_fraction configuration. However the FMR observation does not expose interval-aggregated boundary fluxes or accepted-substep traces, so continuity reconstruction is not connected to FMR and live solute transport is not qualified. The branch has selected an optional typed salt component plus an independent template/restart layout identity; this design is proposed, not canonically accepted or implemented. No Jarvis interface was changed and no salinity capability is qualified/admitted. Exact B1.11 solute-member bytes, common-state/clone/restart implementation, and live accepted-substep transport binding remain open. At checkpoint 0d83f16819f3bbe6d1a97481252d842fbe2aed86, `advance_mobile_salt_trace` and exact O0/O2 reversal, water continuity, late-failure rollback, and deterministic retry/restart replay tests are added; the branch runner passes. This API is not wired to FMR, and salinity remains unqualified.

source_family_census.initialization: SWINCO != 3 interpolates ZC/CML input to nodes; SWINCO = 3 consumes a warm-start concentration profile and does not reapply the initial table (source-family only).
source_family_census.state: CML is mobile-water concentration; CMSY is dissolved plus adsorbed mass per bulk soil volume; column inventory integrates CMSY over node thickness.
source_family_census.transport: Surface input, inter-node advective/dispersive flux, bottom exchange, lateral drainage, root uptake, optional decomposition; internal solute substeps.
source_family_census.root_salt_uptake: TSCF*qrot*CML is a solute-mass sink; must use the same candidate/accepted qrot as the one root-water sink.
source_family_census.ownership: Dedicated solute-state owner advances candidate salt mass and commits/rolls it back with the physical transaction; Jarvis reads concentration only.
source_family_census.exact_source_limit: All equations and lifecycle details above are source-family corroboration only, not byte-exact B1.11 claims.
